what: crates/hir-ty-borrowck/src/lib.rs check_def: borrow checking runs on items rustc has no MIR body for, so hir reports BorrowckSkipped (`blaze cannot borrow-check X: IncompleteExpr` / `TraitFunctionDefinition`) on them. Seen on ~100 blaze-diagnostics tests: every enum variant without an explicit discriminant (DefWithBodyId::VariantId, body root Expr::Missing), every trait fn and assoc const without a default, and every fn without a body. Fix: in check_def, before the inference checks, return BorrowckResult::default() when `Body::of(db, def)` has `body[body.root_expr()]` == Expr::Missing (rustc builds no body there, so there is nothing to check or refuse); parse errors that leave a Missing root are already reported by the parser.

history.note: applied: hir-ty-borrowck check_def returns an empty BorrowckResult (nothing checked, nothing refused) when the body's root expression is Expr::Missing: a fn or associated item without a body, a variant without a discriminant, as rustc builds no MIR there. Ready for the next round
